description: Land Title Settlement Department - Dediyawala, Kalutara D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530002 (23/0706)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, ownership details, extents, and property characteristics. The content focuses entirely on land registration and title settlement processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title matters.
